description: In reaction to the 'Secure the Open Frontier' measure and increasing regulatory pressure on open-weight models, a decentralized network of developers and digital rights advocates forms the Open Source AI Resistance Network (OSARN). This loose coalition begins publishing unregulated model variants, organizing legal challenges to licensing restrictions, and offering technical support to entities defying EU oversight. The movement frames itself as defending innovation and decentralization against bureaucratic overreach, drawing parallels to historical cryptography battles.
